item.title: America is in a turkey slump
item.description: There are a few possible explanations for why Americans are eating less turkey. One of the most quintessential American things is having roasted turkey on the table at a Thanksgiving feast. While that remains the norm, Americans are eating much less of this kind of poultry today than in the past. Annual consumption has fallen by more than 25% over the past three decades, while demand for chicken has soared....
